All other endpoints (auth, home, discover, institutions, creators, albums, tracks, videos, livestreams, playlists, challenges, events, charts, world, genres, search, library toggle+list, analytics) work correctly.

critical.issue: Returns 401. Root cause: /app/backend/seed_data.py line 268 uses random.sample(pool, n) for each institution's creator pool. Trinity Laban (UK) pool has 8 members and picks only 4 randomly, so Zara Adebayo (index 0) is not always included. When Zara isn't in creators collection, server.py line 164 (`await db.creators.find_one({"email": email})`) returns None and demo user for zara is never created. Fix: force-include demo creators (Maya, Kenji, Zara, Luca, Noah) first, then random-sample the remainder from each institution's pool.

action_items: Fix seed_data.py to guarantee inclusion of demo student creators (Maya, Kenji, Zara, Luca, Noah) in their institution's creator pool before random sampling. This ensures zara@ancrmedia.com login works deterministically across DB re-seeds.

seed_data.py uses random.sample without a fixed seed for creator selection, causing non-deterministic seed state — demo users tied to specific creators may vanish. Either use random.seed(N) at start of seeding, or force-include demo creators.
Registration endpoint accepts field 'name' (not 'display_name'); response uses lowercase email — behavior is correct but should be documented.

rca of the issue: zara login 401: /app/backend/seed_data.py:268 uses `chosen = random.sample(pool, n)` with n=4 out of 8 UK pool members. Zara Adebayo is at index 0 of UK pool (line 64) but only picked probabilistically. When not picked, no creator row is created for her, and server.py:164 startup demo-user loop skips inserting her user record because `db.creators.find_one({'email': 'zara@ancrmedia.com'})` returns None. Reproduction: drop DB, restart backend, attempt login with zara. Mitigation: in seed_data.py ensure demo creators are always included — e.g., move the fixed-name demo creators to the front and only random-sample remaining slots, or set random.seed().
